logline: Implementation Intentions: You set your Monday goal and still freeze at your desk—because deciding *what* you want never tells your mind *when* to start. Backed by Peter M. Gollwitzer (71% vs 32% Completion).
director_vision: An intimate psychological thriller aesthetic in Cinematic 35mm Documentary (Humanized Portra 400). Grounding abstract decision theory in tangible physical textures, dramatic directional chiaroscuro, and purposeful camera choreography that mirrors the cognitive trap of Implementation Intentions.
soundtrack_theme: Analog suspense score anchored at 45Hz sub-bass, Mid/Side vocal pocket ducking, and tactile physical Foley reflecting Implementation Intentions.
